title: Retail store, new construction — Mayagüez (no delegation agreement on file), urban zone X
description: We will build a new one-story hardware store on a commercial lot we own in Mayagüez. It is new construction.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN. (KB: RULE_0002, RULE_0620)
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI). (KB: RULE_0003)
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado). (KB: RULE_0651)
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal). (KB: RULE_0004)
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises (Q_PHYSICAL_LOCATION) -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009). (KB: RULE_0007)
RULE_0643: project_type new_construction -> construction permit (Ley 161-2009). (KB: RULE_0643)
Mayagüez is not on the Junta de Planificación's list of municipalities administering a delegation agreement: OGPe issues the construction permit.
Without a delegation agreement the use permit also stays with OGPe.

mustNotInclude.rationale: Pin in FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway.
Pin outside any JP historic zone: RULE_0730 needs location.historic_zone.inside.
Pin outside the floodway: RULE_0732 needs location.flood_zone.floodway.
No renewable installation: RULE_0610 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No renewable installation: RULE_0611 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No microgrid stated: PT_MICROGRID needs microgrid_configuration=true.

notes: Added 2026-10-04 (KB gaps): negative control for autonomous-municipality routing — a municipality without a delegation agreement on file keeps OGPe as the issuing agency.
